description: This file defines the Compat class which provides a compatibility layer for retrieving user profiles across different Android API levels. It abstracts the difference between APIs available in different Android versions to fetch user profiles.

classes.name: Compat
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to obtain user profile information, with compatibility handling for different Android API levels.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Returns a list of UserHandle objects representing user profiles available on the device, using appropriate APIs depending on Android OS version.
